name: Lianson Fleet Group Berhad
summary: Lianson Fleet Group Berhad, an investment holding company, provides vessel chartering, ship management, and offshore marine services to the oil and gas related industries in Malaysia, Singapore, Vietnam and Brunei. The company offers in-field support that offers ample deck space and offshore construction activities. It also provides anchor handling and towing functions; and serves as a safety standby rescue and firefighting vessels for oil spill response and recovery efforts.
